messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>

Subject: Novatech - post-call TCO recap & next steps

Thanks for the time today — great conversation. Below is a concise recap of the pains, goals, and the cost levers we discussed, plus proposed next steps. Let me know if I missed anything.

Key pain points (from Novatech):
- Unpredictable token spend month-to-month; spikes during data-dumps and seasonal campaigns.
- High per-token inference cost for chat flows that have long context/history.
- Occasional latency spikes impacting interactive UX during peak concurrency.

Goals / Success criteria:
- Reduce monthly inference spend by ~30-50% while keeping output quality intact.
- Maintain 95th percentile latency under 350ms for single-stream chat.
- Pilot within a 2-3 week window and produce a data-backed TCO estimate for scaling to production.

Cost levers we discussed (how Redwood can help):
- Token economics: measure current avg tokens/request and tokens/day to baseline savings.
- Batching & concurrency: tuned batching (batch sizes and max latency) to improve GPU utilization for throughput-heavy endpoints.
- Prefix/KV caching: automatic caching for repeated context (session prefixes) to avoid re-computing tokens.
- Quantization & model sizing: recommend a quantized model variant (INT8) or smaller family for stateless endpoints.
- Reserved capacity vs hosted: compare committed Dedicated slots vs burstable hosted for predictable pricing.

High-level first-pass estimate (very rough, based on numbers you shared):
- Current: ~2M tokens/day, average seq length ~80, cost ~$16k/mo (inferred).
- With batching + caching + INT8 quant: expected 30-45% reduction in per-token $ (depends on hit-rate / batching profile).

Next steps (proposed):
1) I will share a TCO workbook with detailed assumptions (tokens/day, model family, batching profiles).
2) Rafael will send a concrete pricing/commitment comparison for Dedicated vs Hosted.
3) Schedule a pricing & security touchpoint with your infra/security (30-45 min) — Rafael and I will join.
4) Optional: 2-week pilot (small reserved capacity + telemetry) to measure real savings.

Please confirm availability for a follow-up: Tue or Wed morning PT next week works on our side.

Thanks again — excited to dig in.
—
Marissa Cole

Hi Samira / Michael — following up with the workbook and a concise assumptions sheet attached. See attachments: redwood_tco_estimate_Novatech.xlsx and redwood_token_econ_example.pdf. Short summary of the assumptions used in the estimate: 

- Baseline: 2,000,000 tokens/day, avg seq length 80, current infra costs approximated from your notes.
- Model: redwood-3b quantized (INT8) for stateless generation endpoints; for RAG/chat we keep the larger family but enable prefix caching.
- Batching: target effective batch size 24-32 for throughput endpoints; interactive chat uses adaptive small batching to preserve latency.
- Cache hit-rate assumed: 18% (conservative); higher hit rates increase savings materially.

Modeling result (conservative): ~38% reduction in monthly inference cost vs current profile. Detailed line-items + sensitivity analysis are in the attached workbook.

Next logistics:
- Rafael (me) will join Wed 10am PT for the pricing + security session. I'll bring the SOC 2 summary and an example KMS integration note.
